verses.text: The LORD said, “Go buy a clay jar from a potter, and take along some of the people’s elders and some of the senior priests.
Go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom by the entrance to the Harsith Gate. Say out loud what I tell you there.
Say, ‘Kings of Judah and people of Jerusalem, listen to the LORD. The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says, “I’m bringing disaster on this place. The news will make everyone’s ears ring.
They walked away from me and made this place unclean. The people, their ancestors, and the kings of Judah burned incense here to gods they hadn’t known. They filled the place with innocent blood.
They built worship sites for Baal so they could burn their children as offerings to him. I never commanded that or said anything about it. It never even crossed my mind.
So look, the days are coming,” says the LORD, “when people won’t call this place ‘Topheth’ or ‘the valley of the son of Hinnom’ anymore. They’ll call it ‘the valley of Slaughter.’

“‘“Right here I’ll wreck the plans of Judah and Jerusalem. I’ll make them fall by the sword in front of their enemies, at the hands of those out to kill them. I’ll leave their bodies as food for the birds and wild animals.
I’ll make this city a horror and a place people hiss at. Everyone who walks past will stare in shock and hiss at what’s happened to it.
I’ll make them eat the flesh of their own sons and daughters. They’ll even eat their friends when their enemies lay siege and the people hunting them for their lives close in.”’
“Then smash the jar where the men who came with you can see it,

and tell them, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “That’s how I’ll smash these people and this city, like a clay jar you can’t put back together. They’ll bury people in Topheth until there’s nowhere left to bury them.
That’s what I’ll do to this place and the people who live here,” says the LORD. “I’ll turn this city into another Topheth.

The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of Judah’s kings have been made unclean and will end up like Topheth. That includes every house where people burned incense to the whole host of heaven on the roof and poured out drink offerings to other gods.”’”
Jeremiah came back from Topheth, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy. He stood in the courtyard of the LORD’s house and spoke to everyone.
“The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Look, I’m bringing on this city and all its towns every disaster I declared against it. They’ve stiffened their necks so they won’t listen to me.’”
